32500.meaning1: delight in views; happiness with beliefs

examples.text: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

32501.meaning1: acceptance of a view after consideration; approving a view after understanding it
32501.commentary: (ANa) mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā'ti amhākaṃ nijjhāyitvā khamitvā gahitadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ sametī'ti'pi mā gaṇhittha.

examples.text: etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.

32503.meaning1: support for views; foundation for opinions; basis for beliefs

examples.text: passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, taṃ diṭṭhinissayaṃ yaṃsa diṭṭhinissayaṃ nissayato na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
imesañ'ca, cunda, pubb'antasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ imesañ'ca apar'antasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya evaṃ mayā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā paññattā.

32504.meaning1: way of acquiring a view; acquisition of belief
32504.commentary: (MNt) diṭṭhi'y'eva paccayavasena paṭiladdhatāya diṭṭhipaṭilābho. saññāpaṭilābhe'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: diṭṭhipaṭilābhaṃ'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam'pi, asevitabbam'pi, tañ'ca aññam'aññaṃ diṭṭhipaṭilābhaṃ.

32505.meaning1: breakthrough of vision; penetration of view

examples.text: satinepakke tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñ'ca satinepakke avigatapemo. diṭṭhipaṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñ'ca diṭṭhipaṭivedhe avigatapemo.

32506.meaning2: (one) who has achieved insight; who has achieved (nibbāna) through insight

32509.meaning1: stuck in views; settled in theories; entrenched in opinions; with rigid dogma

examples.text: ye kec'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā, idam'eva saccan'ti vivādayanti, sabb'eva te nindam'anvānayanti, atho pasaṃsam'pi labhanti tattha.
sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.

32510.commentary: (ANa) diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānan'ti katamāni aṭṭhārasa diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānāni? yā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ diṭṭhisallaṃ diṭṭhisambādho diṭṭhipalibodho diṭṭhibandhanaṃ diṭṭhipapāto diṭṭh'ānusayo diṭṭhisantāpo diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhigantho diṭṭh'upādānaṃ diṭṭh'ābhiniveso diṭṭhiparāmāso. imāni aṭṭhārasa diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānānī'ti evaṃ vuttaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ.

examples.text: yāvatā, āvuso, diṭṭhi yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhiadhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamugghāto, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi tam'ahaṃ passāmi.

32511.meaning1: fever for views; burning passion for beliefs

examples.text: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.
tesañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññam'aññassa vacīsaṃhāro uppajjeyya diṭṭhipalāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi.

32514.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhipaḷāso'tiādīhi cittassa anārādhaniyabhāvo kathito. (ANa) diṭṭhipaḷāso'ti diṭṭhiṃ nissāya uppajjanako yugaggāhalakkhaṇo paḷāso diṭṭhipaḷāso nāma.

examples.text: tesañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññam'aññassa vacīsaṃhāro uppajjeyya diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi.

32516.meaning1: purification of view; purity of opinion

examples.text: iti evarūpiṃ diṭṭhipārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, diṭṭhi-pārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

32517.meaning1: factor related to striving for the purification of view

examples.text: iti evarūpiṃ diṭṭhipārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, diṭṭhi-pārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

32518.meaning1: thirst for views; craving for beliefs

examples.text: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

32519.meaning1: attained understanding; (or) attained through view; epithet of a stream-enterer or higher
32519.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭh'antaṃ patto'ti diṭṭhippatto. tatr'idaṃ saṅkhepalakkhaṇaṃ, dukkhā saṅkhārā, sukho nirodho'ti ñātaṃ hoti diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phusitaṃ paññāyā'ti diṭṭhippatto. vitthārato pan'eso'pi kāyasakkhi viya chabbidho hoti. ten'ev'āha, idh'ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā… ayaṃ vuccati puggalo diṭṭhippatto'ti (pu. pa. 208).

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, api nu tvaṃ, bhaddāli, tasmiṃ samaye ubhatobhāgavimutto vā hosi paññāvimutto vā kāyasakkhi vā diṭṭhippatto vā saddhāvimutto vā dhamm'ānusārī vā saddh'ānusārī vā'ti?

katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo diṭṭhippatto? idha ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te na kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā.

32521.commentary: (DNa) sammādiṭṭhiṃ vināsayamānā uppannā diṭṭhi eva byasanaṃ diṭṭhibyasanaṃ.

examples.text: ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa

32522.meaning1: because of a disastrous belief; due to failure in view

examples.text: sīlabyasanahetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhibyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca byasanāni.

32523.meaning1: underlying tendency towards thinking I am; underlying tendency towards self-comparison

examples.text: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti

32524.meaning1: infatuation with views; fixation on beliefs

examples.text: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

32526.meaning1: yoke of beliefs; bondage of views
32526.commentary: (ANa) sassatadiṭṭhisahagato ca rāgo dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo ca diṭṭhiyogo … diṭṭhīsu yojetī'ti diṭṭhiyogo.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, yogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogo, bhavayogo, diṭṭhiyogo, avijjāyogo.

32527.meaning1: detachment from the bond of beliefs
32527.meaningLit: unyoking from the yoke of view
32527.commentary: (DNa) arahattamaggo bhavayogavisaññogo nāma. sot'āpattimaggo diṭṭhiyogavisaññogo nāma. arahattamaggo avijjāyogavisaññogo nāma.

examples.text: cattāro visaññogā, kāmayogavisaññogo, bhavayogavisaññogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaññogo, avijjāyogavisaññogo.

32528.meaning1: detachment from the bond to views; disconnection from bondage to beliefs

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, visaṃyogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogavisaṃyogo, bhavayogavisaṃyogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaṃyogo, avijjāyogavisaṃyogo.

32529.meaning1: passion for views; love of beliefs

examples.text: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

32530.meaning1: passion for a view, attachment to it, bondage to it, greed for it, obsession with it, and fixation with it; love of a belief, adherence to it, being tied to it, craving for it, being consumed by it, and addiction to it
32530.constructionSummary: diṭṭhirāga + abhinivesa + vinibandha + paligedha + pariyuṭṭhāna + ajjhosāna
32530.construction: diṭṭhirāga + abhinivesa + vinibandha + paligedha + pariyuṭṭhāna + ajjhosāna
32530.sanskrit: dṛṣṭi + rāga + abhiniveśa + vinibandha + pari + gṛddha + paryavasthāna + adhyavasāya

examples.text: atthi pana, bho kaccāna, koci lokasmiṃ yo imañ'c'eva kāmarāg'ābhinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhān'ajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto, imañ'ca diṭṭhirāg'ābhinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhān'ajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto'ti?

32531.meaning1: due to passion for a view, attachment to it, bondage to it, greed for it, obsession with it, and fixation with it; because of love of a belief, adherence to it, being tied to it, craving for it, being consumed by it, and addiction to it
32531.constructionSummary: diṭṭhirāga + abhinivesa + vinibandha + paligedha + pariyuṭṭhāna + ajjhosāna + hetu
32531.construction: diṭṭhirāga + abhinivesa + vinibandha + paligedha + pariyuṭṭhāna + ajjhosāna + hetu
32531.commentary: (ANa) kāmarāg'ābhinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhān'ajjhosāna-hetū'ti kāmarāg'ābhinivesahetu, kāmarāgavinibandhahetu, kāmarāgapaligedhahetu, kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhānahetu, kāmarāgaajjhosānahetū'ti attho. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yv'āyaṃ pañca kāmaguṇe nissāya uppajjati kāmarāgo, tass'ābhinives'ādihetu. kāmarāgena abhiniviṭṭhattā vinibaddhattā tasmiṃ'y'eva ca kāmarāge mahāpaṅke viya paligedhattā anupaviṭṭhattā ten'eva ca kāmarāgena pariyuṭṭhitattā gahitattā kāmarāgene'va ca ajjhositattā gilitvā pariniṭṭhapetvā gahitattā'ti. diṭṭhirāg'ādipadesu'pi es'eva nayo.
32531.sanskrit: dṛṣṭi + rāga + abhiniveśa + vinibandha + pari + gṛddha + paryavasthāna + adhyavasāya + hetu

examples.text: ko pana, bho kaccāna, hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇā'pi samaṇehi vivadantī'ti? diṭṭhi-rāg'ābhinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhān'ajjhosāna-hetu kho, brāhmaṇa, samaṇā'pi samaṇehi vivadantī'ti.

32533.meaning1: bond of belief; fetter of views
32533.commentary: (PMa) diṭṭhigatiko hi ekasmiṃ patiṭṭhātuṃ na sakkoti, kadāci sassataṃ anussarati, kadāci ucchedaṃ. diṭṭhi'y'eva anatthe saṃyojetī'ti diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ.

examples.text: satta saññojanāni, anunayasaññojanaṃ, paṭighasaññojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ, mānasaññojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ, avijjāsaññojanaṃ.

32535.meaning1: eradication of views; extermination of beliefs

examples.text: yāvatā, āvuso, diṭṭhi yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhiadhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamugghāto, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi tam'ahaṃ passāmi.

32536.commentary: (ANa) samuṭṭhānan'ti diṭṭhiṭṭhānass'eva vevacanaṃ. vuttañ'h'etaṃ. khandhā paccayo diṭṭhīnaṃ upādāya samuṭṭhān'aṭṭhenā'ti sabbaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.

examples.text: yāvatā, āvuso, diṭṭhi yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhiadhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamugghāto, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi tam'ahaṃ passāmi.

32538.meaning1: right view; successful attainment of view; epithet of stream entry
32538.commentary: (DNa) diṭṭhisampadā'ti tattha katamā diṭṭhisampadā? atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhaṃ… sacchikatvā pavedentī'ti yā evarūpā paññā pajānanā'ti evaṃ āgataṃ diṭṭhipāripūribhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ. (ANa) diṭṭhisampadā'ti sammādiṭṭhikabhāvo. tena kammassakata-sammādiṭṭhi, jhānasammādiṭṭhi, vipassanāsammādiṭṭhi, maggasammādiṭṭhi, phalasammādiṭṭhīti sabbā'pi pañcavidhā sammādiṭṭhi saṅgahitā hoti.

examples.text: sīlasampadā ca diṭṭhisampadā ca.

32539.meaning1: because of the successful attainment of view; due to attaining the correct outlook

examples.text: diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso sampadāti.

32540.meaning1: having right view; with correct outlook; with correct belief

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, yathārūpāya dhammatāya diṭṭhisampanno puggalo samannāgato, aham'pi tathārūpāya dhammatāya samannāgato'ti.
seyyathā'pi gāvī taruṇavacchā thambañ'ca ālumpati vacchakañ'ca apacinati. evam'eva kho dhammatā esā diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa

32542.meaning1: arrow of views; barb of belief

32544.meaning1: bond of belief; fetter of views

examples.text: diṭṭhisaṃyojanasaṃyutto, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā'ti vadāmi

32545.meaning1: attached to the chain of views; fettered with the bond of views
32545.commentary: (MNa) idāni'ssa tam'eva bandhan'atthaṃ dassento diṭṭhi-saṃyojana-saṃyutto'ti-ādim'āha. tass'āyaṃ saṅkhep'attho. iminā diṭṭhisaṃyojanena saṃyutto puthujjano etehi jāti'ādīhi na parimuccatī'ti.

examples.text: diṭṭhi-saṃyojana-saṃyutto, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā'ti vadāmi

32546.meaning1: with views in common; with beliefs in harmony (with)

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu y'āyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya tathārūpāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhisāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvi c'eva raho ca.

32550.meaning1: affection for views; love for beliefs

examples.text: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

32551.meaning2: Chapter 15 of the Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

32552.meaning1: due to belief; due to views

32553.commentary: (DNa) diṭṭhivipattī'ti tattha katamā diṭṭhivipatti? n'atthi dinnaṃ n'atthi yiṭṭhan'ti evaṃ āgatā sammādiṭṭhivināsikā micchādiṭṭhi. (ANa) diṭṭhivipattī'ti micchādiṭṭhi. (VSa) garukānaṃ dvinnaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ vasena sīlavipatticodanā veditabbā

examples.text: sīlavipatti ca diṭṭhivipatti ca.
ācāravipattiyā vā diṭṭhivipattiyā vā anuddhaṃseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anupasampannaṃ anuddhaṃseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

32554.meaning1: because of a wrong view; due to failure in outlook

examples.text: cittavipattihetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti, diṭṭhivipattihetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vipattiyo'ti.

32555.meaning1: deluded view; distorted opinion; inversion of view
32555.commentary: (PMa) diṭṭhivirahitasseva akusalacittassa sakakiccassa balavakāle cittavipallāso. diṭṭhisampayutte citte diṭṭhivipallāso.

examples.text: anicce, bhikkhave, niccan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso. dukkhe, bhikkhave, sukhan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.

32556.commentary: (SNa) sukhumaṃdiṭṭhivipassakan'ti arahattamaggadiṭṭhiyā sukhuma-diṭṭhi-phala-samāpatti-atthāya vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā āgatattā vipassakaṃ.

examples.text: taṃ jhāyinaṃ sātatikaṃ, sukhumaṃ diṭṭhivipassakaṃ, upādānakkhay'ārāmaṃ, āhu sappuriso itī'ti.

32557.meaning1: writhing of views; contortion of views
32557.commentary: (NIDD1a) kadāci sassatassa, kadāci ucchedassa gahaṇato diṭṭhiyā virūpaṃ phanditan'ti diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ

32558.meaning1: for the sake of purity of view; for the purpose of purification of belief

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, diṭṭhivisuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
evam'eva kho, āvuso, sīlavisuddhi yāva'd'eva cittavisuddh'atthā, cittavisuddhi yāva'd'eva diṭṭhivisuddh'atthā, diṭṭhivisuddhi yāva'd'eva kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddh'atthā

32559.meaning1: purity of view; purification of belief

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, diṭṭhivisuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, diṭṭhivisuddhi anupādāparinibbānan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

32560.meaning1: distorted view; twisted belief; contorted concept

examples.text: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ

32562.meaning1: having a view; having the opinion; holding the belief

examples.text: ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī, yo koci diṭṭhaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me diṭṭhan'ti, n'atthi tato doso

32563.meaning1: who has a view; who has the opinion

examples.text: diṭṭhena ce suddhi narassa hoti, ñāṇena vā so pajahāti dukkhaṃ, aññena so sujjhati sopadhīko, diṭṭhī hi naṃ pāva tathā vadānaṃ.

32564.meaning1: fixed view; rigid idea; dogmatic opinion; attachment to view

examples.text: diṭṭhīnivesā na hi svātivattā, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, tasmā naro tesu nivesanesu, nirassatī ādiyatī ca dhammaṃ.
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, upādānaṃ? cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, upādānāni, kām'upādānaṃ, diṭṭh'upādānaṃ, sīlabbat'upādānaṃ, attavād'upādānaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, upādānaṃ.

te na sammā sabb'upādānapariññaṃ paññapenti, kām'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na diṭṭh'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na sīlabbat'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na attavād'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti.

32566.meaning1: in this life; in this world

examples.text: diṭṭhe dhamme ca yo attho, yo c'attho samparāyiko, atth'ābhisamayā dhīro, paṇḍito'ti pavuccatī'ti.
kittayissāmi te dhammaṃ, diṭṭhe dhamme anītihaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
yattha kho, āvuso, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, n'āhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ diṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyan'ti vadāmī'ti.

32568.meaning1: in this life; right here right now; in the present

examples.text: ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti.
saddhassa, bhikkhave, sāvakassa satthusāsane pariyogāhiya vattato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā'ti.

32569.meaning1: in this life; right here right now; in the present

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'evadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan'ti
so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya, paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā, asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā, avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā, diṭṭh'evadhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti

32570.meaning1: flood of views; torrent of beliefs
32570.notes: cattāro oghā 1. kāmogha, 2. bhavogha, 3. diṭṭhogha, 4. avijjogha.

examples.text: mahā udakaṇṇavo'ti kho, bhikkhave, catunn'etaṃ oghānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, kām'oghassa, bhav'oghassa, diṭṭh'oghassa, avijj'oghassa.

32571.meaning1: you are seen; you've been discovered

examples.text: gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayam'ajjhagā.
sevamāno sevamānaṃ, samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ, saro diddho kalāpaṃ'va, alittam'upalimpati. upalepabhayā dhīro, n'eva pāpasakhā siyā.

32575.meaning1: smeared with poison; dipped in venom

examples.text: kaṃ, bhikkhave, diddhagatena visallena sallena vijjhatu, sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātu.
tadā catasso gāthāyo, ganthayitvā subyañjanā, santhavitvā tilok'aggaṃ, desayissaṃ dine dine.
so suṇeyya bherisaddam'pi mudiṅgasaddam'pi saṅkhapaṇavadindimasaddam'pi. tassa evam'assa, bherisaddo iti'pi, mudiṅgasaddo iti'pi, saṅkhapaṇavadindimasaddo iti'pi.

32583.meaning2: given, offered, allowed, granted, handed over
32583.commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.10) dinnaṃ nāma kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā dente hatthapāse ṭhito kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā paṭiggaṇhāti, etaṃ dinnaṃ nāma.

examples.text: appasm'eke pavecchanti, bahun'eke na dicchare, appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā, sahassena samaṃ mitā'ti.
kāle dadanti sappaññā, vadaññū vītamaccharā, kālena dinnaṃ ariyesu, ujubhūtesu tādisu, vippasannamanā tassa, vipulā hoti dakkhiṇā.
tiṇadosāni khettāni, rāgadosā ayaṃ pajā, tasmā hi vītarāgesu, dinnaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.
ye puggalā aṭṭha sataṃ pasatthā, cattāri etāni yugāni honti, te dakkhiṇeyyā sugatassa sāvakā, etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

32588.meaning2: fact of being given; state of being offered (to)

examples.text: so satthārā dinnanaye ṭhatvā satthāraṃ vanditvā, ajja ādiṃ katvā mama santakaṃ dasikasuttamattam'pi maṃ abhibhavitvā anekasatā'pi rājāno vā corā vā gaṇhituṃ samatthā nāma mā hontu, agginā'pi mama santakaṃ mā ḍayhatu, udakena'pi mā vuyhatū'ti patthanaṃ akāsi.

32591.meaning1: expecting what is offered; wanting (only) what is offered

examples.text: adinn'ādānaṃ pahāya adinn'ādānā paṭivirato ahosiṃ dinn'ādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī, athenena sucibhūtena attanā vihāsiṃ

sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni c'eva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti tesañ'ca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpentī'ti.
dinno suṅko yassa rañño so'yaṃ dinnasuṅko, rājā.

32596.meaning1: taking what is given; accepting what is offered

examples.text: apāṇ'ātipātaṃ nissāya pāṇ'ātipāto pahātabbo. dinn'ādānaṃ nissāya adinn'ādānaṃ pahātabbaṃ. saccavācaṃ nissāya musāvādo pahātabbo. apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbā.

32597.meaning1: accepting what is offered; taking what is given

examples.text: adinn'ādānaṃ pahāya adinn'ādānā paṭivirato ahosiṃ dinn'ādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī, athenena sucibhūtena attanā vihāsiṃ
